content: The OCU driver shall perform Inter Module Checks to avoid integration of incompatible files.Th e imported included files shall be checked by preprocessing directives. The following version numbers shall be verified: - <MODULENAME>_AR_RELEASE_MAJOR_VERSION - <MODULENAME>_AR_RELEASE_MINOR_VERSION Where <MODULENAME> is the module short name of the other (external) modules, which provide header files included by the OCU driver . If the values are not identical to the expected values, an error shall be reported.
